captions_note: the cards ARE the words while the slot plays: only what matters, never the whole sentence, so the reel's captions are hidden for the whole slot. Every word said in the slot that matters goes into a card; the rest is simply not on screen
in_a_reel: pick a line with one or two words that carry it (a number, a name, the payoff): WORDS holds only those, e.g. 'tenemos un 15% de margen en todas nuestras ventas' -> '15%' big + 'margen' small
build with GRADE=0 so the slot matches the reel's colour
keep the zooms gentle (1.1 to 1.3): a tight zoom leaves no room above the head and the cards drop to the chest
end the ZOOMS list with a pull back to 1.0 before the slot ends, unless the slot ends on a cut
make the slot with --hi when the original clip is wider than 1080 px
steps: run onsets.py      # 1. onset frame of every word; then edit the CLIP block (ZOOMS, WORDS)
run track.py      # 2. eye track. LOOK at work/track_check.jpg (cross between the speaker's eyes in every tile)
run build.py GRADE=0      # 3. camera + cards + index.html. Read the card lines: behind or front, sizes, any !!
run bake.py      # 4. assets/zoom.mp4 + assets/zoom_cut.webm (the speaker through the same crop), 1 to 3 min
hf snapshot --at <one time just after each card's big word>
run build.py GRADE=0      # 6. guide off again
run post.py      # 7. frame count, phone copy, stills, work/qa/sheet_*.jpg
